slug: 2025-06-10 Guinea-Bissau deploys efforts to digitize birth registration, national ID systems

facts.fact: Guinea-Bissau's civil registration is being digitized through the new Integrated System of Citizen Registers and Statistics (SIREC), with registration on the platform begun about three months before the interview and civil-registry officers trained on enrolment kits, per Raul Gomes of the Ministry of Justice.

systems.system: SIREC (Integrated System of Citizen Registers and Statistics)

slug: 2024-01-01 Building a National Identification System - Scanning and Digitizing the Civil Registry Books in Guinea-Bissau

facts.fact: A UNDP project with Swiss co-financing is developing complete software to digitize the civil registry (births, deaths, marriages and annotations) as the main national platform, and setting up a digitization centre for the paper registry books, with the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights as beneficiary.

systems.system: civil registry digitization software (UNDP Building National ID project)

facts.fact: SIREC, built by Universidade de Aveiro with birth, marriage and death modules, was launched at the 1.a Conservatoria de Bissau and issued its first certificate, moving civil registration from paper to digital.

systems.owner: Direcao-Geral de Identificacao Civil, Registos e Notariado

facts.fact: The SIREC page says the system, funded by the EU and implemented by the Direcao-Geral de Identificacao Civil, Registos e Notariado, processes civil registration data including births in a single integrated database.
The SIREC page says the system registers deaths (obito) alongside births and marriages, with fully digital storage of registration acts.

systems.owner: Direcao-Geral de Identificacao Civil, Registos e Notariado

note: Describes mobile birth registration by civil registry officials, with no digital register named.

facts.fact: UNDP says the Santa Luzia Civil Registry Office in Bissau is the first in the country to operate entirely digitally on SIREC, replacing paper registry books, and over 2.4 million records (11,745 registers) are digitised.
UNDP says officials at Santa Luzia record births, marriages and deaths directly on the national platform SIREC.

systems.owner: Government of Guinea-Bissau (EU and Camoes Institute funded)

facts.fact: UNICEF says birth registration is now done digitally on a tablet platform in hospitals and health centres in three regions (Bissau, Tombali, Quinara), with over 20,000 children aged 0 to 7 registered from October 2024 to June 2025.
